decode.scroll_stop_trick: A four-panel medical-poster timeline: three small back-view figures with an orange glow on the problem area shrinking DAY 6 → 12 → 27, then one big clean result panel next to the product. The glow tells the story without a word.
decode.angle_carried: love handles & cortisol belly dissolved by day 28 — Adrien's 5-round template (Loom 4: keep the small glow on the result panel too)
decode.hidden_reading: heat-map authority: the glow is 'where it's working', so the result panel with a faint glow reads as still working
decode.scene_logic: three small cards left to right, same figure from behind, glow shrinking; one large card below with the result and the product; ours = the back of a woman's lower legs (calves, ankles, heels) in the same cards, glow on the calves and ankles
decode.visual_trick: the template's visual code: an orange glow marks where the body is working; ours = soft orange glow on the swollen tissue, shrinking panel by panel and still present, small, on the result panel (Adrien Loom 4 on this template) — copy exactly, including the result panel
decode.shape_or_function_equivalent: love handles (back view, waist) ↔ calves and ankles (back view, knee down); amber bottle bottom-right ↔ pouch bottom-right, never squashed (Adrien Loom 2: jar squashed → redo)
decode.render_style: flat vector illustration, soft navy card borders on white, muted skin, orange radial glow, light grey background
decode.text_treatment: bold condensed caps headline, black with the deadline in blue; day labels in white on navy chips; footnote tiny italic bottom centre

strategy.angle: A8-L heavy, swollen legs drained by day 30
strategy.mechanism: M1: when the body can't clear everyday oxidative stress, the tissue in the legs stays inflamed and stops draining normally, so fluid sits there — heavy, tender, puffy — and no diet reaches it, because it was never fat; the tablet turns a glass of water into hydrogen-rich water, hydrogen is the smallest molecule there is, reaches the tissue and helps the body switch that process off so normal drainage can resume
strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: calves tight and hot by evening · cause: inflamed tissue holding fluid · tried: elevating, compression, water tablets
strategy.belief_installed: It was never fat. It's fluid my body stopped clearing — and no diet reaches it.

people.customer_look: back view of the lower legs of woman 40–55, soft midlife build, ordinary clothes, visibly swollen heavy calves and ankles (sock marks, puffy ankles) — never a young fitness model, dark shorts or a skirt hem at the top of the frame

visual_bans: glow is orange and only on calves/ankles; never red, never a rash look
the pouch keeps its real proportions — not stretched to fill the corner
the product is only ever a white effervescent tablet in a clear glass of water — no other dosage form, no blister pack, no sachet
no bottle, jar or tub for Edenvia — the container is the stand-up pouch of Image 1, label untouched
any glass holds clear water with fine rising bubbles; never hot water, tea or coffee in that glass
no competitor brand name, logo or bottle shape anywhere (brand.json banned list)
no disease or drug name on the image
_note: Adrien's 5-round template: jar squashed (L2) → more colour on the result (L3) → keep the small glow on the result (L4) → 'great' (L5). Our first try applies all three lessons.
